title: AS2: try/catch/finally compilation (ActionTry)
description: Verify ActionTry (0x8F) is emitted for try/catch/finally blocks in the AS2 compiler. ActionTry has a variable-length header: flags byte, catchOffset, finallyOffset, endOffset, optional catch variable name. Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/trycatch.test.ts: try/catch compiles and contains 0x8F, catch variable is named correctly, finally block compiles, nested try/catch works, rethrow in catch works.
